'''Thoren Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Scapio]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Recopia]]. Thoren Spaceport was the only port on Recopia that was capable of handling [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger starliners]].<ref name="CCW" />
